title: Chapter 184: Occupy Or Destroy
content:
Chapter 184: Occupy Or Destroy

"Wang Shuo, are you really going to kill us all?" Zhao Tianze was panicking, but he still shouted loudly.

He was begging for mercy, but he still looked arrogant.

Wang Shuo felt uncomfortable.

"Hey, you didn't take the wrong medicine! You don't think that this war is a child's play, do you?" Wang Shuo sneered and quickened his pace.

"I am willing to compensate you. You name the amount. I am willing to give you gold coins, energy crystals, and even some special props, as long as you let me go."

Zhao Tianze was a little anxious. He just used a substitute straw doll, which made him feel distressed and felt the taste of death.

Wang Shuo shook his head and showed a playful smile.

"Stupid, if you die, these are also mine!"

Because of the Swift Scout Team Medal and the speed bonus of the Legion Order.

Wang Shuo and the others quickly caught up with Zhao Tianze.

The flaming spear drew a graceful arc in the air and swept directly towards Zhao Tianze.

And Ayub's Qinglong sword also attacked from the other side.

Zhao Tianze had no way to avoid it. In a panic, he had to take out a shield, but he could only defend in one direction.

Ayub's machete directly knocked him off his horse.

"Wang Shuo, if you spare my life, I can be loyal to you!"

Wang Shuo was unmoved and stabbed him in the head with a gun.

Zhao Tianze rolled over and dodged the attack in a panic.

"I also know a big secret. If you just let me go, I am willing..."

Before he could finish, Ayub's Qinglong sword slashed directly at his neck.

A look of fear appeared on his face, and his eyes were full of despair!

"Purple Thunder Breaks the Sky."

"-1200"

Wang Shuo did not hesitate at all, and the flaming spear pierced his head and killed him with one shot!

"You will be damned forever with your secret!" Wang Shuo sneered.

But at this moment, Zhao Tianze's body mysteriously disappeared again!

Moreover, Wang Shuo also heard a sentence vaguely.

"... I will come back..."

Not dead yet?

Wang Shuo was surprised. It turned out to be a disaster for thousands of years!

The battle situation was urgent. Wang Shuo did not think too much. He immediately turned his horse's head and returned to the main battlefield. He shouted to the battlefield: "Zhao Tianze is dead, why don't you put down your weapons and surrender!"

"Surrender and you will not be killed!"

"Surrender and you will not be killed!"

The cavalry behind him also shouted.

The archers whose formation was disrupted were the first to react.

They immediately put down their bows and arrows, held their heads with their hands, and squatted on the ground.

They did not have any strong feelings for Fengze Village. After all, they were forced to join this village in the past few days. It was good enough if they did not resent it.

Under the threat of death, they surrendered decisively.

Next came the fiercest battle between the sword soldiers and shield soldiers. Seeing that the archers had surrendered, most of them also put down their weapons.

Only a few people still wanted to resist stubbornly, still holding their weapons, standing among a group of surrendered soldiers, looking particularly annoying.

But they didn't hold on for long!

In the end, everyone surrendered.

In this battle, the number of casualties in Wana Village was less than 10, but it caused more than 100 casualties in Fengze Village.

And nearly 700 people were captured.

It can be said that it was a great victory.

After Wang Shuo took over all the people in the territory, he came to the core of the territory.

[You can choose to occupy or destroy the core of Fengze Village. 】
